field.label: Priority Sequence
field.help: Rules are evaluated from lowest number to highest (e.g. 10, 20, 30).

field.label: Rule Description
field.help: Example: Bypass RU domains and IPs

field.label: Domains / GeoSite
field.help: Type and press Enter. Examples: geosite:ru, geosite:category-ads-all, domain:ya.ru, full:myip.ru

field.label: IPs / Subnets / GeoIP
field.help: Type and press Enter. Examples: geoip:ru, geoip:private, 192.168.0.0/16, 8.8.8.8/32

field.label: Destination Port(s)
field.help: Optional port or range (e.g., 53, 443, 1000-2000). Leave empty for any port.

field.label: Sniffed Protocol
field.help: Select sniffed protocols to match (multi-select): http, tls, quic, bittorrent. Leave empty for any protocol.

field.label: Target Outbound Action
field.help: Route matching traffic to one of the outbounds in the list: «Standard (core)» — built-in direct and block; «Custom (from outbound nodes)» — the nodes enabled in the Outbound section, each tagged node_<uuid> (stable across add/remove/reorder). Unmatched traffic goes direct.
